Dubai / UAE Student Visa Process

Official step-by-step roadmap from university offer to visa stamp

1

Application & Offer Letter

Submit academic transcripts and passport to receive admission offer.

2

Pay Tuition Fee Deposit

Pay university tuition deposit + visa processing fee.

3

University Applies for Entry Permit

University processes official Entry Permit through GDRFA / ICP.

4

Fly to Dubai & Medical Fitness Exam

Arrive in Dubai on Entry Permit, complete medical test and Emirates ID biometrics.

5

Emirates ID & Residence Visa Stamping

Receive 1-year renewable UAE Student Residence Visa and Emirates ID card.

Frequently Asked Questions

Country-specific answers verified by ALO Education compliance

Are degrees from Dubai branch campuses identical to the UK/Australia parent campus?

Yes, branch campuses like University of Birmingham, Heriot-Watt, and University of Wollongong issue identical degree certificates without mentioning 'Dubai' on the parchment.

How long does Dubai student visa processing take?

Dubai student visa processing takes just 10 to 15 working days, making it the fastest visa processing route for Bangladeshi students.

Is bank statement or financial solvency required for Dubai student visa?

No lengthy 6-month bank statement is required by immigration; the visa is directly sponsored by your university upon tuition deposit payment.

Can I transfer to the UK or Australia campus after 1 year in Dubai?

Yes, many universities allow students to complete 1-2 years in Dubai and transfer seamlessly to the UK/Australia parent campus.

Can international students work in Dubai?

Yes, students can obtain a student work permit through their university's Career Centre to work part-time or complete paid internships.

Are IELTS exemptions available for Dubai universities?

Yes, many universities accept Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificates or conduct internal English placement tests.

Can Bangladeshi students with study gaps apply to Dubai?

Yes, Dubai universities have flexible study gap policies, accepting 5 to 10+ years of study gap with relevant professional experience.

What is Dubai Knowledge Park (DKP) and DIAC?

DKP and Dubai International Academic City are dedicated higher education free zones hosting over 30 international university campuses.

What are the main intake seasons in Dubai?

September (Fall) is the main intake, with secondary intakes in January (Winter) and May (Summer).

What is the cost of living for a student in Dubai?

Average living cost ranges from 2,500 to 4,500 AED per month including student housing, food, and metro transport.

What medical tests are required after arriving in Dubai?

A standard blood test (HIV/Hepatitis) and chest X-ray (Tuberculosis) conducted at a DHA medical fitness center in Dubai.

What is Emirates ID?

Emirates ID is the official government identification card issued to all UAE residents, used for banking, transport, and student services.

Can polytechnic diploma holders apply to Dubai universities?

Yes, 4-year BTEB diploma graduates can apply for Bachelor's degree entry with subject exemptions.

Is personal income taxed in Dubai?

No, there is 0% personal income tax in the UAE, allowing you to keep 100% of your earnings.

What scholarships are available in Dubai?

Universities offer academic merit scholarships ranging from 15% to 50% tuition reduction for high-achieving students.

Can I sponsor my family in Dubai after graduation?

Yes, once you transition to a standard UAE Employment Visa or Green Visa meeting salary requirements, you can sponsor your family.

What British universities have campuses in Dubai?

University of Birmingham, Heriot-Watt University, Middlesex University Dubai, University of Stirling, and De Montfort University.

What Australian universities have campuses in Dubai?

University of Wollongong in Dubai (UOWD), Curtin University Dubai, and Murdoch University Dubai.

What is the student accommodation in Dubai like?

Universities offer modern, air-conditioned student residences (such as The Myriad and KSK Homes) with swimming pools, gyms, and shuttle buses.

Does ALO Education assist with Dubai university admissions?

Yes, ALO Education provides complete free processing from university selection to Entry Permit and flight arrangements.
